capabilities: plot 2D functions of x in a fenced code block
plot 3D functions of x and y
render scatter points on the graph
customize graph appearance (colors, line width, labels, dark mode)
save generated plot images to a configured vault folder
extras: Works only on the desktop app. README warns generation can be slow and suggests lowering the number of plot points; a known PATH error is fixed by setting the full Julia executable path in settings.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render function graphs; Math (LaTeX) only typesets equations and does not compute or draw them.
summary: Code-block plugin that plots 2D and 3D functions as images inside notes by running Julia with the Plots package.
